status.label: Status
status.intro: Travel plugins must be ready. For combat, only what you picked under General → Combat needs to be ready. Auto-shop needs Knightshopper.
status.shopping_intro: Auto-shop Returns to base camp if needed, then starts Knightshopper’s Occult Crescent list when your silver/gold threshold is hit. Configure the list in Knightshopper.
status.optional_intro: Wrath Combo and Rotation Solver Reborn also need BossMod or BossMod Reborn.
